headline: KenGen Seeks Sh1.55 Trillion to Finance New Kenyan Power Generation
summary: Kenya Electricity Generating Company is seeking about Sh1.55 trillion from private investors, commercial lenders, and development partners to fund new power infrastructure.
why: Capital-intensive energy infrastructure projects require extensive project financing, offering participation opportunities for institutional lenders and development partners.

impacts.name: Kenyan Energy Sector
impacts.why: Capital fundraising supports long-term power generation development.
